facts.value: There may also be a limited number of fee-paying places available on your desired course. Students who are self-financing may have the option to receive funding from four other sources.
You can pay your course fee yourself and pay in instalments.

In many instances, your employer may refund you the cost of your course as you complete each semester. You should discuss this with your HR or training department. Your employer may be eligible to pay your fees on your behalf and receive government funding to do so.

Tax relief may also be available for those in employment. To claim relief on a postgraduate course, you must already have an undergraduate degree or equivalent qualification. For more information, please visit Revenue.ie.
Student Loans may also be a consideration.
